name: Lavaridge Town
lines:
The Sturdy Ability protects Pokémon from one-hit KO
moves like Fissure!
But that’s not all!
It also protects the Pokémon when a normal attack
was strong enough to have made it faint in one blow.
I want to acquire that kind of raging strength of my
own as a single man!

On Mt. Chimney’s peak, there’s a local
specialty that you can buy only there.
Give one to a Pokémon—it will be elated.
